title: Live: Premier League Soccer
description: Nottingham Forest host Manchester City in Matchweek 10 of the Premier League at the City Ground. Forest sit 19th after one win in four league games, while City arrive second in the standings but have lost their last two league games.

title: Live: College Football
description: The No. 1 Miami Hurricanes (8-0) face the No. 11 Notre Dame Fighting Irish at Notre Dame Stadium. Miami enters this matchup undefeated this season after beating North Carolina 38-35, while Notre Dame beat Navy 35-13 behind C.J. Carr's two touchdowns.
